messages:
elaine_sales: Heads up — POC with FinHealth. They're asking for a 60-day POC (starts Apr 1) + data residency in eu-west. Requesting 20% discount and a 6-month commit credit if we convert. Need deal-desk flow and approvals. cc @mike_dealdesk @jia_pricing

jia_pricing: Quick note: ad-hoc POC discounts without exec signoff usually capped at 25%. Commit-credit requests trigger the commit policy (requires SOW + finance signoff). Provide ARR impact calc.

mike_dealdesk: Please create a Deal Desk ticket with the exception form and attach the ARR calc + proposed SOW. If commit credit is requested we escalate to Director of Sales and loop Legal/Finance. Tagging @anna_ops for billing implications.

anna_ops: Billing implications: if we convert POC -> paid, we can credit pro-rata up to 3 months. For 6-month commit-credit, ops requires a signed SOW and explicit invoice schedule. Also mark the order as 'commit-credit' in our billing system for internal metrics.

sam_engineer: Technical constraints: for EU data residency we can provision region-isolated hosted or Private. Private has ~6 week lead time; hosted region isolation ~2 weeks. For the 60-day POC we can pin model to rwd-small-1 and throttle throughput. Need expected concurrency and token volume to size.

mike_dealdesk: Runbook excerpt for POC exceptions:
```
- Step 1: Open Deal Desk ticket (template: exceptions/poc_request)
- Step 2: Attach ARR impact calc, SOW (convert clause if applicable), security questionnaire
- Step 3: Pricing review: confirm discount <= 25% w/o exec signoff; <=20% preferred if conversion clause included
- Step 4: If commit credit requested -> escalate to Director (email + CC finance/legal)
- Step 5: Ops: confirm deployment type and lead times before committing dates
```

jia_pricing: To be specific — if you include a convert-to-commit clause in the SOW, cap the POC discount at 20% and add a renewal uplift target in the terms. Avoid creating legacy SKUs or grandfathered pricing.

elaine_sales: Timeline: POC begins Apr 1, final pricing needed by Mar 25 to get SOW signed. I'm going to aim for hosted + region isolation to meet timelines. @mike_dealdesk I'll drop the ARR calc and client ask here in 10m.

mike_dealdesk: Opening ticket now: https://internal/dealdesk/195777-poc-exception — added checklist and assigned to Director for CC. :thumbsup:

legalbot: Auto-check: SOW must include data residency clause, liability/indemnity limits per enterprise standard, and explicit convert-to-commit language if used. Flagging Product Security for review.

product_security: I'll need the client's security questionnaire and network/KMS diagrams by EOD Mar 20 for a quick review. If they require Private deployment, expect deeper review.

anna_ops: Final ops note: if the customer insists on Private/on-prem we need procurement lead time + network approvals; budget ~6 weeks. Hosted + region isolation is the fast path.

elaine_sales: Sounds good. For now we proceed with hosted region isolation and 20% discount with Director CC and conversion trigger (we'll propose: convert if >=75% usage within 90 days or executed SOW). I'll attach client email and ARR calc shortly. Thanks everyone. :heart:
